purpose: Evidence gate for comparative low-speed / turning-model inputs, not a historical aircraft database

oswald.status: Greg worksheet inferred, not independently measured
oswald.basis: Greg 325-mph drag split, 6371-lb assumed weight implies e about 0.558; cannot validate airframe independently

stallSpeed.basis: No matched-weight, calibrated, primary flight-test stall EAS found

oswald.status: related-variant Greg worksheet inferred, not measured
oswald.basis: P-47 D-28-style high-power, 13065 lb Greg worksheet implies e about 0.784; power and aerodynamic configuration not identical to P-47B

stallSpeed.basis: P-47 manual correction chart begins at 170 mph IAS, above the quoted 115 mph IAS clean stall; no extrapolation permitted

clMax.basis: v0.7 nominal CLmax=1.60; 86 mph IAS clean power-off stall at 8000 ft and 9270 lb is not corrected CAS/EAS

oswald.basis: No independently fitted full low-speed polar for the modeled B-15 specimen

stallSpeed.basis: Wright Field Eng-47-1749-A 20 May 1944 reports 86 mph IAS at 8000 ft, 9270 lb, gear/flaps up, shutters closed, power off; the same report's airspeed-calibration chart does not cover 86 mph IAS

method.note: A wartime test report's IAS figure is evidence of an IAS stall, not proof of CLmax until converted to calibrated/equivalent airspeed at a matched test weight and configuration. Published generic aerodynamic sensitivity cannot substitute for that correction.
